description:
This protocol automates sample plating from collection tubes to a 96-deepwell plate.  
Using a Single-Channel Pipette, this protocol will transfer the user-specified volume from sample tubes placed in the Opentrons Tube Rack into a 96-well plate. Samples are transferred top to bottom, and then left to right (rack 1 tube A1 to plate well A1, rack 1 tube B1 to plate well B1, rack 1 tube C1 to plate well C1, rack 1 tube A2 to plate well D1, etc).
If you have any questions about this protocol, please email our Applications Engineering team at protocols@opentrons.com.


To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our online store or contact our sales team at info@opentrons.com

Opentrons OT-2
Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 4.1.0 or later)
Opentrons P300 GEN2 Single-Channel Pipette
Opentrons 200µl Filter/300µl Standard Tips
Opentrons 4-in-1 Tube Rack Set with 3x5 15ml tube insert for Avantik 3ml Viral Transport Medium Tubes #GL4692
NEST 96 Deepwell Plate 2mL
